questions.question: How many Medicare-certified hospice facilities were operating nationwide in 2023?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('cms_program_stats_providers_2023.xlsx', sheet_name='MDCR PROVIDERS 1_CPS_19PRV', header=None)
header_row = df[df.iloc[:, 0].astype(str).str.contains('Type of Facility', na=False)].index[0]
years = [str(val).strip() for val in df.iloc[header_row]]

questions.question: In calendar year 2023, did Florida have more Medicare-certified short stay hospital beds than California?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('cms_program_stats_providers_2023.xlsx', sheet_name='MDCR PROVIDERS 4_CPS_19PRV', header=None)
header_row = df[df.iloc[:, 0].astype(str).str.contains('Provider State', na=False)].index[0]
cols = [str(val).strip() for val in df.iloc[header_row]]
short_stay_bed_col = [i for i, c in enumerate(cols) if 'Short Stay Hospital Beds' in c and 'Per 1,000' not in c][0]

fl_beds = float(df[df.iloc[:, 0].astype(str).str.strip() == 'Florida'].iloc[0, short_stay_bed_col])
ca_beds = float(df[df.iloc[:, 0].astype(str).str.strip() == 'California'].iloc[0, short_stay_bed_col])

result = 'yes' if fl_beds > ca_beds else 'no'
questions.check_program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('cms_program_stats_providers_2023.xlsx', sheet_name='MDCR PROVIDERS 4_CPS_19PRV', header=None)

header_row_idx = None
for idx, row in df.iterrows():
    if row.astype(str).str.contains('Short Stay Hospital Beds', case=False).any():
        header_row_idx = idx
        break

headers = df.iloc[header_row_idx].tolist()
beds_col = None
state_col = 0
for col_idx, val in enumerate(headers):
    if str(val).strip() == 'Short Stay Hospital Beds':
        beds_col = col_idx
        break

data = df.iloc[header_row_idx + 1:].copy()
fl_beds = float(data[data[state_col].astype(str).str.strip() == 'Florida'][beds_col].values[0])
ca_beds = float(data[data[state_col].astype(str).str.strip() == 'California'][beds_col].values[0])

result = 'yes' if fl_beds > ca_beds else 'no'

questions.question: Which three states had the highest number of Medicare-certified ambulatory surgical centers in 2023?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('cms_program_stats_providers_2023.xlsx', sheet_name='MDCR PROVIDERS 5_CPS_19PRV', header=None)
header_row = df[df.iloc[:, 0].astype(str).str.contains('Provider State', na=False)].index[0]
cols = [str(val).strip() for val in df.iloc[header_row]]
asc_col = cols.index('Ambulatory Surgical Centers')

start_idx = header_row + 1
end_idx = df[df.iloc[:, 0].astype(str).str.contains('Territories', na=False)].index[0]
state_df = df.iloc[start_idx:end_idx].copy()
state_df = state_df[~state_df.iloc[:, 0].astype(str).str.strip().isin(['All Areas', 'United States', 'BLANK', ''])]
state_df['asc'] = pd.to_numeric(state_df.iloc[:, asc_col], errors='coerce')
top3 = state_df.sort_values(by='asc', ascending=False).head(3)
result = top3.iloc[:, 0].str.strip().tolist()

questions.question: What was the net change in the number of Medicare nurse practitioners between 2019 and 2023?

import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('cms_program_stats_providers_2023.xlsx', sheet_name='MDCR PROVIDERS 6_CPS_19PRV', header=None)
header_row = df[df.iloc[:, 0].astype(str).str.contains('Specialty', na=False)].index[0]
years = [str(val).strip() for val in df.iloc[header_row]]
col_2019 = years.index('2019')
col_2023 = years.index('2023')

np_2019 = float(df.iloc[np_row, col_2019])
np_2023 = float(df.iloc[np_row, col_2023])

questions.question: Between 2018 and 2023, in which calendar year did the total count of Medicare-certified hospitals peak?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('cms_program_stats_providers_2023.xlsx', sheet_name='MDCR PROVIDERS 1_CPS_19PRV', header=None)
header_row = df[df.iloc[:, 0].astype(str).str.contains('Type of Facility', na=False)].index[0]
years = [str(val).strip() for val in df.iloc[header_row][1:]]

total_hosp_row = df[df.iloc[:, 0].astype(str).str.strip() == 'Total Hospitals'].index[0]
counts = [float(df.iloc[total_hosp_row, i]) for i in range(1, 1 + len(years))]
max_year = years[counts.index(max(counts))]
result = str(max_year)
